svg.text: Everyday English - Small talk
How is your workload
looking this week?
MEANING
A friendly way to check on someone's stress
level or availability.
IN CONTEXT
How is your workload looking this week? I have
some time to help with the project figures.
USAGE NOTE
This shows empathy for their busy schedule. It
is less intrusive than 'What are you doing?'
CONVERSATION
A: Hi, how is your workload looking this week?
B: It is quite heavy, actually.
A: Is there anything I can help with?
B: That would be great, thanks.
A: What specific task is the hardest?
B: The data entry is taking all my time.
A: I can handle that for you today.
B: That would be a huge help.
YOUR TURN
What is a good follow-up if they say it is busy?
Model Answer: 'Is there anything I can help
with?'
